d: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's Asphalt 6
ld: Asphalt 6: Adrenaline is Gameloft's arcade racing game, originally released for Android as Asphalt-6-Adrenaline-v1.3.3-offline.apk (package com.gameloft.android.ANMP.GloftA6HP).
req:
- A PS Vita / PS TV console running Custom Firmware (HENkaku or Enso), firmware 3.60/3.65 or later recommended.
- kubridge and FdFix installed as kernel plugins (ur0:tai/config.txt under *KERNEL).
- libshacccg.suprx installed in ur0:data/ (required — the engine compiles its GLSL shaders at runtime).
